"""Stress: per-run distinct enabled transition sets (guard-dependent preambles)."""
import json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/tests')
from kbuild import *

NS = 2048
NRUNS = 2048
STATES = ["INITIAL"] + ["s%d" % i for i in range(1, NS + 1)]
types = [
    {"name": "State", "kind": "enum", "values": STATES},
    {"name": "Msg", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
    {"name": "N", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
]
mod = {"name": "m", "params": [["state", "State"], ["message", "Msg"], ["n", "N"]],
       "result": ["res", "Msg"], "requires": None}
# transition i (chain i->i+1) enabled iff n >= i; runs with n=k enable prefix 0..k
transitions = []
for i in range(NS):
    transitions.append({"from": STATES[i], "to": STATES[i + 1], "command": "c%04d" % i,
                        "cost": 1, "when": ["ge", ["var", "n"], ["const", "N", i]]})
machine = {"states": STATES, "initial": "INITIAL", "state_param": "state",
           "message_param": "message", "transitions": transitions}

def mchars(s, n=4):
    return [ord(c) for c in s.ljust(n, '\x00')]

def mk(state_idx, msg, n):
    seq = [("x0", le(state_idx, 4))]
    for i in range(4):
        seq.append(("x%d" % (2 + i), le(mchars(msg)[i], 1)))
    seq.append(("x6", le(n, 2)))
    for i in range(4):
        seq.append(("x%d" % (8 + i), le(0, 1)))
    return {"entry": "m", "ktest": b64(ktest(seq))}

# run r: n = r, target = s(r+1) -> needs transitions 0..r all enabled (n=r enables i<=r) -> reachable
runs = [mk(1 + r, "m%03d" % r, r) for r in range(NRUNS)]
# a few unreachable: n < needed
runs.append(mk(2000, "zz", 5))
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": [mod], "calls": [], "pipes": [],
            "entries": ["m"], "machine": machine, "runs": runs}
data = json.dumps(campaign).encode()
print("input bytes:", len(data))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', '-B', '/workspace/project/campaign_cli.py'],
                   input=data, capture_output=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
print("rc=%d time=%.1fs out=%d" % (p.returncode, dt, len(p.stdout)))
out = json.loads(p.stdout)
assert [r['status'] for r in out['records'][:-1]] == ['READY'] * NRUNS
assert out['records'][-1]['status'] == 'UNREACHABLE'
c = out['corpus'][1500]
assert c['commands'] == ["c%04d" % i for i in range(1501)] + ["m500"], (c['commands'][-3:], c['cost'])
assert c['cost'] == 1501
print("stress2 OK")
EOF
cd /workspace && time python3 /workspace/tmp/tests/stress2.py
